'''Fernald:''' {{legend0|#a5b0ff|40–50%}} {{legend0|#7996E2|50–60%}} {{legend0|#6674DE|60–70%}} {{legend0|#0d056c|>90%}} | title = Governor | before_election = [[Jeanne Shaheen]] | before_party = Democratic Party (United States) | after_election = [[Craig Benson]] | after_party = Republican Party (United States) }} {{ElectionsNH}} The '''2002 New Hampshire gubernatorial election''' was held on November 5, 2002. Three-term incumbent [[Democratic Party (United States)|Democratic]] governor [[Jeanne Shaheen]] opted to [[2002 United States Senate election in New Hampshire|unsuccessfully run for the United States Senate]] rather than seek a fourth term as governor. [[Republican Party (United States)|Republican]] [[Craig Benson]], a self-funded businessman, defeated [[Democratic Party (United States)|Democrat]] [[Mark Fernald]], a [[New Hampshire State Senate|state senator]], in the general election after both won contested primary elections.
